topic: Using std::ostream_iterator for Output Stream Iteration
explanation: In modern C++, std::ostream_iterator is a template class that facilitates outputting elements to an output stream (such as std::cout or file streams) using iterator semantics. It allows algorithms to write directly to streams in a clean, generic way, enabling seamless integration with the Standard Template Library (STL) algorithms. This approach promotes a functional programming style and simplifies code that involves outputting sequences of data.
